question: The very first cricket Test match was played on_______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**15 March 1877**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The first Test match took place at the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) in Melbourne, Australia.
 
• The match was played between England and Australia. The England cricket team, led by James Lillywhite Jr., toured Australia to play a series of matches against a representative Australian side.
 
• The match was a four-day Test match. Each team played a single innings, and the team with the highest total runs after both innings won the match.
 
• The first Test match started on 15 March 1877 and concluded on 19 March 1877.
 
• In the first innings, Australia scored 245 runs, and England scored 196 runs. In the second innings, Australia scored 104 runs, and England scored 108 runs.
 
• Australia won the match by 45 runs. This historic victory marked Australia's first Test match win.
 
• The first Test match between England and Australia laid the foundation for what would become the pinnacle format of cricket.
 
• The match established the concept of international Test cricket and paved the way for the Ashes series, which commenced in 1882.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Cricket:

 
• Cricket is a bat-and-ball sport played between two teams of eleven players each.
 
• It is believed to have originated in England during the 16th century.
 
• The sport involves hitting a ball with a bat and scoring runs by running between two sets of wooden wickets.
 
• Cricket has its own set of rules, formats (such as Test cricket, One-Day Internationals, and Twenty20), and international competitions.
